raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (377 rows, matching the 377 rows with source_tz='UTC') stores txn_ts in UTC, while every other batch is America/Chicago local time. The UTC timestamps are 5-6 hours ahead of local time, so those transactions land on the wrong business date and in the 00:00-06:00 window. Converting UTC-sourced timestamps to America/Chicago local time in silver_transactions corrects txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', txn_ts)) ELSE txn_ts END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', txn_ts)) ELSE txn_ts END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
